init_distributed: initialize the distributed PyTorch backend with nccl or gloo based on the cuda flag
all_reduce_item: all-reduce a scalar value across distributed workers using sum, mean, min, max, or product
sync_workers: synchronize all distributed workers and yield the current worker rank via a context manager
get_rank: get the current distributed worker rank or zero if distributed is not initialized
get_world_size: get the total number of distributed workers or one if distributed is not initialized
